messages:
alex: Midday async standup — quick sync on routing/auth/rate smoothing. What I did / blockers / today. Saw a small spike of 429s during the JWT key rotation, left a short trace.

maria: Did an auth sweep, found fallback to old key in one codepath (token_refresh.go). Rolled a hotfix to the rotation script to prefer new key sooner.

sasha: Repro steps I used — intermittent 429 when token header normalized to `x-rw-token` instead of `authorization`. Quick curl to repro:
```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \\  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\  -H 'Authorization: Bearer BROKEN_TOKEN' \\  -d '{"model":"rwd-small","input":"hi"}'
```
Got: HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests (request-id: rq_8f3a).

tyler: Looked at gateway policy cache code. There's a small race where policy cache invalidation happens after auth middleware reads policy headers, can cause double-eval and unexpected rate accounting. I can repro locally with the curl above + very short token TTL.

alex: Can we roll a canary with the cache ordering fix (policy-read before invalidation) and also enable rate smoothing for that route? I think 5% canary is safe.

maria: Pushed canary to us-west-2 at 12:35 PT, config: `policy-cache-order=v2`, `rate-smoothing=150ms`. Early metrics: p50 latency +7ms, 429s down ~90% for impacted keys. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: route-policy-order-fix v2 -> 5% (3/60 instances). Logs: deploy/1798802500/ok

sasha: Ping @tyler for CR #4821 on the gateway ordering change. Small doc update needed in runbook under "jwt rotation fallout".

tyler: Will review PR in ~45m. Blocker: need an extra unit test that simulates concurrent policy invalidation; I'll add it and push.

alex: Today I'll finish the rollout playbook (steps + rollback), add a follow-up to measure token TTL distribution, and coordinate with SRE for a broad postmortem if we see recurrence.

maria: One leftover: I saw one session still failing — attaching the mini-flare: `session=usr_90ab; route=embed-micro; error=429; token_kid=old-key-4`. I'll keep watching and will escalate if it reappears.

sasha: Thanks team — leaving notes in the PR and runbook. If no one objects, we'll widen canary to 20% after tyler's unit test lands.

alex: Agreed. Thanks everyone. Quick thumbs if you're unblocked or ping if you need pairing. :white_check_mark:
